title: India Travel Highlights
summary: From Rann Utsav to Shimla, Char Dham, and Kerala, this guide covers India’s most beloved travel experiences for modern explorers.
bestTime: Oct–Feb for Rann Utsav and Himalayan escapes; Sep–Mar for Kerala backwaters and south coast travel.

quickFacts.Language: Hindi & regional languages; English widely spoken in tourism.
quickFacts.Travel Tip: Book festival and pilgrimage stays early, especially for Rann Utsav and Char Dham season.

attractions.name: Rann Utsav
attractions.summary: A cultural festival in the white salt desert of Kutch with crafts, food, and desert camping.

attractions.name: Shimla Hill Station
attractions.summary: Colonial charm, cool weather, scenic walks, and easy access to nearby Himalayan valleys.

attractions.name: Char Dham Pilgrimage
attractions.summary: Spiritual journey to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath with sacred mountain shrines.

attractions.name: Kerala Backwaters
attractions.summary: Houseboat cruises, tea hill stations, and Ayurvedic wellness in God’s Own Country.

cultureEtiquette: Dress modestly when visiting temples and pilgrimage sites.
Remove shoes before entering religious buildings and private homes.
Respect local customs around food, photography, and elders.
gettingAround: Use trains for scenic north-south travel and book early for festival season.
Hire a private car with driver for Char Dham circuits and Himachal hill station transfers.
Book local ferries and houseboats in Kerala for the best backwater experience.

itineraries.title: Kerala Backwaters
activities: Enjoy fresh seafood and coconut rice

sustainability: Support local artisans and handicraft sellers at Rann Utsav.
Respect temple rules and local pilgrims during Char Dham travel.
Choose eco-friendly backwater stays and avoid plastic waste in Kerala.

faqs.q: When is the best time to visit Rann Utsav?
faqs.a: October to February is the ideal period when the desert festival is in full swing and the weather is pleasant.

faqs.q: How do I book Char Dham travel?
faqs.a: Book with an experienced operator who handles permits, transport, and accommodations for a safe pilgrimage.

faqs.q: What is special about Kerala backwaters?
faqs.a: A houseboat cruise through palm-lined canals and quiet villages is the signature Kerala travel experience.
